summary: CollPlant Biotechnologies Ltd filed a routine Form 6-K on September 24, 2026, furnishing a press release about its subsidiary LightSolver Ltd. The release covers peer-reviewed joint research with the High-Performance Computing Center Stuttgart, published through the 23rd ACM International Conference on Computing Frontiers, benchmarking LightSolver's photonic Laser Processing Unit emulator against GPU-based iterative algorithms and projecting time-to-solution acceleration of roughly 40x to over 80,000x on sparse linear systems. No transaction, securities offering, board recommendation, advisor, or financial terms are involved; this is an ordinary disclosure of operational and scientific progress, not a special situation, with no deal or risk-arb angle to monitor.
